title: Bellender Fuchs
author: Jugrü
changes: Red fox (Vulpes vulpes) giving one bark. Used for the arctic fox because no arctic fox recording under an allowed licence with a clearly audible call was found; the red fox is a close relative in the same genus. Trimmed to 0.45–1.40 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. No high-pass: the excerpt has no measured low-frequency rumble.
